reason: I've got years of runs in Strava and my watch, and my crew already coordinates there and in KakaoTalk, so I'm not going to start logging Han River runs in a second app. Half my crew is on iPhone anyway, so an Android-only crew run feature falls apart before we even leave the start line.
objection: Virtual shoes, gacha pulls and repairing gear with points is STEPN all over again, just without the cash. If the points are worthless, the shoe game is busywork, and if that ever changes I don't want my crew anywhere near it.
would_change_my_mind: If it synced with Strava or my watch so I didn't have to double-log, and there was an iPhone version so my whole crew could join the same run room.
